Protecting

A protected workbook can only be changed in its unlocked cells: this is how to prepare a worksheet.

Preparing a sheet for students

  1. Select the cells to be filled in, right-click › Unlock cells.
  2. or Tools › Protect / Unprotect workbook.
  3. Save, then share the file or its link.

All cells are locked at first; locking only has an effect in a protected workbook. Lock cells reverts it.

What protection blocks

In a protected workbookLocked cellUnlocked cell
typing, deletingnoyes
calendar of a datenoyes
widths and heightsnono
alternating colors, inserting checkboxes and lists, filling by menunono
formatting, inserting rows and columns, chartsyesyes

Protection covers all the sheets. It is saved in the Excel file, with the unlocked cells, and read back by DocCells and Excel.

Student mode

?mode=student in the address opens DocCells without the button or the Unlock cells and Define name… commands; Protect / Unprotect workbook is grayed out. The student cannot remove the protection.

https://…/doccells/?mode=student&url=https://…/exercise.xlsx

This is a protection of use, without a password: anyone who opens the file in another spreadsheet, or without mode=student, can remove it.
